rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact new mechanism: a learned per-recurrent-block anchor refresh gate. The tail anchor is no longer frozen for the whole reverse sweep; each recurrent block can partially refresh the anchor toward its updated state, which may improve late-block recurrence alignment and export robustness without changing shapes, eval, or the quant-aware endgame. The edit is small, compile-stable, and stays in the proven 9x512 recurrent-tail family.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh
